{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/merge_duplicates.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"One-time script for LIFE-203: merge duplicate household records.

Keeps the record with a valid household ID in each duplicate group and marks
the others as "merged" into it. No record is deleted; no other fields change.

Run once:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py
"""

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households, set_status


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households(active_only=False)
    n_before = len(households)
    groups = find_duplicates(households)
    print(f"found {len(groups)} duplicate group(s)")

    merge_map = {}
    for group in groups:
        valid = [hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(hid)]
        if not valid:
            print(f"group {group}: no valid household ID, leaving untouched")
            continue
        kept = valid[0]
        for other in group:
            if other != kept:
                merge_map[other] = kept
                set_status(other, "merged", merged_into=kept)
        print(f"group {group}: kept {kept}")

    # Verify: nothing deleted, one active record per group, kept IDs valid.
    after = load_households(active_only=False)
    active = {h.id for h in load_households(active_only=True)}
    assert len(after) == n_before, "records were deleted"
    for group in groups:
        kept = next((hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(hid)), None)
        if kept is None:
            continue
        assert is_valid_household_id(kept)
        assert len(active & set(group)) == 1 and kept in active, f"group {group}"
    print("verification passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
